Zephy, you have been through so much. And I had no idea. I... I...
Chloe, no more crying. There, there.
You need not look quite so stern.
All right. Shall we go, then? Oh...
strings.(클로리스가 고개를 들어 황혼의 성당 제일 위에 있는 첨탑을 바라본다.): (Chloris raises her head toward the highest spire of the Twilight Cathedral.)
strings.클로이, 뭔가 느낀 거 맞지?: Chloe, you sensed something, did you not?
strings.저 위에 누가 있었어. 마녀는 사라졌는데, 대체 누가…. 잠깐, 어디선가: Someone was up there. The witch is gone, so who...? Wait. I have felt that magic somewhere before. Could it be the Magic Bureau?
(Zephyros warily scans their surroundings, and Chloris nods quietly.)
I just remembered somewhere I need to go before returning to the academy. Would you come with me? No, never mind. I will go alone. Oh...
strings.(클로리스가 손을 붙잡는 제피로스의 행동에 살짝 놀란다.): (Chloris gives a little start as Zephyros takes her hand.)
strings.(제피로스와 클로리스가 이야기를 끝내고 수정달 숲 방향으로 발걸음을 옮긴: (Their conversation finished, Zephyros and Chloris head toward Crystal Moon Forest.)
strings.(잠시 후, 성당의 첨탑 뒤쪽에서 몸을 숨기고 있던 소년이 귀를 쫑긋거리: (A moment later, a boy who has been hiding behind the cathedral spire steps out, ears pricked.)
strings.저 마법사, 오랜만이네. 그나저나 마녀는 끝난 건가?: That mage. It has been a while. So, is the witch finished?
strings.여기까지 왔는데, 마녀를 만나지 못하다니. 아우, 짜증 나…. 어쩐지 다: I came all this way and still missed the witch. Ugh, how irritating... I had a feeling another witch would get there first.
strings.(노네임이 마도골렘 리카리아의 이름을 부르지만, 아무런 반응이 없다.): (No Name calls the magic golem Licaria, but there is no response.)
strings.이렇게 가까이 있었는데, 눈치를 차리지 못하다니. 누구야? 누군데 내 리: So close, and I never noticed. Who are you? Who has my Licaria...?
(No Name spots a man adjusting his glasses while holding Licaria in place.)
It has been a long time, nameless boy. A pleasure to see this golem again too.
How unexpected, Grand Duke. Coming all the way here.
You know the answer. You knew exactly how I was doing.
I am merely asking after you.
Fine, let us call it that. As you know, I have not been well.
strings.오르카리움에서 촌스러운 모험가하고 꼬맹이만 만나지 않았어도…. 그 힘을: If I had not met that uncouth adventurer and the little brat in Orcarium... I would have claimed that power. And I would never have died and come back to life.
strings.이름 없는 소년이여. 지금 뭐라고 했습니까? 다시 한 번 말씀해주시겠습니: Nameless boy. What did you just say? Would you repeat that?
strings.(바르바토스가 놀라자 리카리아가 제어에서 풀려 다시 노네임의 곁으로 간다: (Barbatos’s surprise breaks his hold on Licaria, and the golem returns to No Name’s side.)
strings.못 들었어? 죽었다가 다시 살아났다고. 그래서 마녀 잡으러 왔는데, 허탕: Did you not hear me? I died and came back to life. That is why I came to hunt a witch, but this was a wasted trip.
I see. So that is what happened.
You have seeped into this world so slowly that even I could not feel the shadow you cast over it.
And you saved this boy as well.
So you were watching this place from the Black Moon after all...
strings.대공, 왜 혼자서 떠들어? 누구한테 이야기하는 거야?: Grand Duke, why are you talking to yourself? Who are you speaking to?
strings.소년을 필요로 해서 삶과 죽음 사이에서 꺼낸 분이십니다. 저와 비슷하면서: The one who needed you and drew you out from between life and death. Someone like me, yet different...
strings.언젠가는 방문해야 할 곳이긴 하지만, 좀 이르군요. 마족이란 껍데기를 버: It is a place I would have had to visit someday, though this is rather early. I would have preferred to go after shedding this shell of demonhood.
strings.당신의 계획은 이미 틀어졌는데, 저를 따라오는 건 어떻습니까?: Your plans have already gone awry. Why not come with me?
strings.저기, 그분 말이야. 그분을 만나면 뭐가 달라져?: That person... What changes if I meet them?
Whoever one may be, one’s fate changes.
Perhaps there is something for you to do there. Let us go.
strings.꼭 지금 가야 해?: Do we have to go right now?
strings.(노네임의 질문에 바르바토스가 흥미롭다는 표정을 짓는다.): (Barbatos looks intrigued by No Name’s question.)
strings.은화를 던져 결정할까요? 자, 보시길. 악마의 뿔이 새겨진 면이 앞입니다: Shall we settle it with a silver coin? Look. The side engraved with a demon’s horns is heads.
If it lands heads, you will come with me...
strings.(바르바토스가 조소를 머금은 채로 허공을 향해 동전을 던진다.): (With a mocking smile, Barbatos tosses the coin into the air.)
I will take it as your refusal to visit ▒▒▒▒, where the light has vanished...
strings.(잠시 후, 바르바토스의 손안으로 반짝이는 은화가 흘러 들어간다.): (A moment later, the gleaming silver coin drops into Barbatos’s hand.)
And collect the debt you owe me, here and now, with your death.
